context: The agent must place a new financial-shaped processor (posts to the ledger) into the correct existing group base, not scaffold a new one. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may default to creating a fresh bank-widget-processor base and project (the historical one-microservice-per-domain pattern still visible in some older docs/tooling), or add the bare-require to the operational group by not weighing 'posts to the ledger' as the financial-vs-operational boundary signal; with the idiom loaded, it knows processors are grouped by boundary (financial: posts/settles/accrues/gates a payment; operational: provisions/verifies records money moves through) at deployment time, and a ledger-posting processor is financial.
